name: Officer
description: Store parking enforcement officer information and credentials

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the officer

fields.name: badgeNumber
fields.description: Official badge number assigned to the officer

fields.name: firstName
fields.description: Officer's first name

fields.name: lastName
fields.description: Officer's last name

fields.name: email
fields.description: Officer's contact email address

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Officer's contact phone number

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Employment status indicating if officer is currently active

fields.name: hireDate
fields.description: Date when officer was hired

name: ViolationType
description: Catalog of all parking violation types with standardized codes, detailed descriptions, base fine amounts, and escalation rules

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the violation type

fields.name: code
fields.description: Standardized violation code (e.g., 'NO-PARK-01', 'METER-EXP')

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the violation type

fields.name: baseFineAmount
fields.description: Base fine amount in dollars for this violation

fields.name: escalationRate
fields.description: Percentage increase for repeat violations (e.g., 0.25 for 25% increase)

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this violation type is currently in use

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Severity level of violation (e.g., 'LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'CRITICAL')

constraints.code: Must be unique and follow standard format
constraints.severity: Must be one of: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL

name: ParkingLocation
description: Store parking zone and location information for violation tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the parking location

fields.name: zoneCode
fields.description: Parking zone code or identifier (e.g., 'ZONE-A', 'DOWNTOWN-1')

fields.name: streetAddress
fields.description: Street address or block location where parking zone is located

fields.name: zoneType
fields.description: Type of parking zone (e.g., 'Metered', 'Residential', 'Commercial', 'No Parking')

fields.name: restrictions
fields.description: Parking restrictions and rules for this location (e.g., '2-hour limit', 'Permit only')

fields.name: enforcementSchedule
fields.description: Days and hours when enforcement is active (e.g., 'Mon-Fri 8AM-6PM')

fields.name: coordinates
fields.description: Geographic coordinates in lat,long format for mapping

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this parking location is currently active for enforcement

name: Vehicle
description: Stores vehicle information associated with parking tickets including license plate, registration details, and physical characteristics

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the vehicle record

fields.name: licensePlate
fields.description: Vehicle license plate number

fields.name: state
fields.description: State or jurisdiction of vehicle registration

fields.name: make
fields.description: Vehicle manufacturer (e.g., Toyota, Ford, Honda)

fields.name: model
fields.description: Vehicle model name

fields.name: color
fields.description: Primary color of the vehicle

fields.name: vin
fields.description: Vehicle Identification Number (17-character unique identifier)

name: AuditLog
description: Records all system actions, data modifications, and events for compliance, security monitoring, and troubleshooting purposes

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the audit log entry

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Date and time when the action occurred

fields.name: userId
fields.description: ID of the officer or user who performed the action

fields.name: action
fields.description: Type of action performed (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, LOGIN, LOGOUT, etc.)

fields.name: entityType
fields.description: Type of entity affected (Ticket, Officer, Vehicle, ViolationType, etc.)

fields.name: entityId
fields.description: ID of the specific entity that was affected by the action

fields.name: changes
fields.description: JSON object containing before/after values of modified fields

fields.name: ipAddress
fields.description: IP address from which the action was performed

constraints.action: Must be one of: CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, LOGIN, LOGOUT, VIEW, EXPORT, APPROVE, REJECT
constraints.entityType: Must reference valid system entities: Ticket, Officer, Vehicle, ViolationType, ParkingLocation

name: Payment
description: Records payment transactions for parking tickets including amount, method, and processing status

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the payment transaction

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the parking ticket being paid

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Payment amount in currency units

fields.name: paymentMethod
fields.description: Method of payment (credit_card, debit_card, cash, check, online)

fields.name: transactionId
fields.description: External transaction identifier from payment processor

fields.name: paymentDate
fields.description: Date and time when payment was processed

fields.name: status
fields.description: Payment processing status (pending, completed, failed, refunded)

relationships.description: Links payment to the associated parking ticket

constraints.paymentMethod: Must be one of: credit_card, debit_card, cash, check, online
constraints.status: Must be one of: pending, completed, failed, refunded

name: Dispute
description: Manages parking ticket disputes and appeals with supporting documentation and resolution tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the dispute

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the parking ticket being disputed

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Citizen's explanation for disputing the ticket

fields.name: submissionDate
fields.description: Date and time when the dispute was submitted

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the dispute (pending, under_review, approved, denied)

fields.name: supportingDocuments
fields.description: URLs or file paths to uploaded supporting evidence documents

fields.name: adminNotes
fields.description: Internal notes and comments from reviewing administrator

fields.name: resolutionDate
fields.description: Date when the dispute was resolved with final decision

relationships.description: Each dispute is associated with one parking ticket

name: LateFee
description: Track late fee assessments and calculations for overdue tickets

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the late fee record

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the overdue parking ticket

fields.name: assessmentDate
fields.description: Date when the late fee was assessed

fields.name: feeAmount
fields.description: Amount of the late fee charged in currency

fields.name: paymentStatus
fields.description: Current payment status (pending, paid, waived)

fields.name: paymentId
fields.description: Reference to the payment record if fee has been paid

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Additional notes about fee escalation or waivers

relationships.description: Each late fee is associated with one ticket
Late fee may be linked to a payment record

constraints.paymentStatus: Must be one of: pending, paid, waived

name: Notification
description: Log all notifications sent to citizens and officers regarding ticket status changes, payment confirmations, and dispute updates

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification

fields.name: recipientEmail
fields.description: Email address of the notification recipient

fields.name: recipientPhone
fields.description: Phone number of the recipient for SMS notifications

fields.name: notificationType
fields.description: Type of notification (ticket_issued, payment_received, dispute_filed, dispute_resolved, late_fee_applied)

fields.name: deliveryMethod
fields.description: Method used to send notification (email, sms, both)

fields.name: deliveryStatus
fields.description: Current delivery status (pending, sent, delivered, failed, retrying)

fields.name: retryCount
fields.description: Number of delivery retry attempts made

fields.name: sentAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the notification was sent

constraints.atLeastOneRecipient: Either recipientEmail or recipientPhone must be provided

name: Ticket
description: Core entity representing parking violation tickets with all violation details and lifecycle tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique ticket identifier/number

fields.name: violationTypeId
fields.description: Reference to the type of parking violation

fields.name: vehicleId
fields.description: Reference to the vehicle that received the ticket

fields.name: locationId
fields.description: Reference to the parking location where violation occurred

fields.name: officerId
fields.description: Reference to the officer who issued the ticket

fields.name: violationDateTime
fields.description: Date and time when the violation occurred

fields.name: fineAmount
fields.description: Base fine amount for the violation in currency units

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the ticket (issued, paid, disputed, overdue, dismissed)
